spec.command: bash -c "cd /root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress && source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 WANDB_MODE=offline python train_baseline_control.py --config configs/baseline_control.yaml --wandb_project smart-compress-vla --wandb_run baseline_control_fresh_lr_v2"

experiment_data.hypothesis: If Smart Compress's 15pp gain over baseline (59.8% vs 44.8%) comes from cross-attention re-encoding rather than extra training, then continuing baseline training for another 100K steps (expert-only, no compressor, fresh lr schedule) should NOT close the gap. If baseline+100K reaches ~60%, the gain was from training; if it stays near 44.8%, cross-attention architecture is the cause.
